# Feature Readiness Checklist: Core Audiobook Ingestion, Session Tracking, and Audio Player

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality review gate validating specification completeness, clarity, edge-case coverage, and testability across all core user stories before or during PR review.
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///home/hai/Du_lieu_hoc_tap/Project/BTL_Python_Project/StudyLab/specs/001-core-audiobook-player/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are file validation requirements explicitly specified for empty, malformed, or unreadable source documents? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK002 Are clause-boundary punctuation rules and fallback behaviors fully defined when a single sentence exceeds the 35-word threshold? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Clarification Q5]
- [x] CHK003 Are schema attributes, length bounds, and uniqueness constraints defined for all required library metadata fields? [Completeness, DataModel §Book, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are lookahead pre-fetch queue sizing and buffer replenishment triggers fully specified to prevent audio underruns? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK005 Are bookmark recovery requirements documented for edge cases where the application process is terminated abruptly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Edge Case]

---

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK006 Is the transition delay between consecutive audio sentences quantified with an objective, testable threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is the initial playback startup latency threshold objectively specified from user trigger to first audible sound? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are the minimum and maximum playback speed boundaries, along with allowable step increments, explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Contract: CLI]
- [x] CHK009 Is the 100,000-word ingestion throughput target defined with measurable time and sentence boundary accuracy limits? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK010 Is the timeout threshold for LAN and Tailscale ping latency probes quantified with an exact duration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Research §7]

---

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Architectural Alignment

- [x] CHK011 Do the CLI argument definitions, exit codes, and JSON response formats align consistently between the specification and CLI interface contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract: CLI]
- [x] CHK012 Are the pluggable TTS provider interfaces consistent across default (Edge-TTS) and optional (OpenAI) implementations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract: TTS]
- [x] CHK013 Do reading session duration calculations align between database schema definitions and session tracking requirements? [Consistency, DataModel §ReadingSession, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Are audio cache naming conventions and key generation formulas consistent between the player specification and cache architecture? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Research §4]

---

## 4. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are user notification and playback pausing requirements defined for mid-session network drop scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for books that reach 100% completion regarding bookmark finalization and session closure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK017 Are normalization requirements specified for text documents containing non-ASCII symbols, unusual whitespace, or unpronounceable formatting artifacts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements specified for handling duplicate book ingestion attempts (same content imported under different names)? [Coverage, Spec §US-1.3, DataModel §Book.content_hash]

## 5. Non-Functional & Resilience Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are offline testability requirements established to guarantee zero live external network requests during automated test execution? [Non-Functional, Constitution Principle II, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK020 Are database connection pooling and automatic reconnection requirements documented to prevent connection pool exhaustion? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Contract: Storage]
